intent.raw: skill rewrite and plan a test with playwright
intent.objective: Rewrite the installed ui-prototyping-studio SKILL to the reversibility model (DEC-026/027) — HUMAN accepts / AUTO auto-accepts / export the one human-confirmed edge, never-do spine rewritten, false 'never accept' removed, new verbs documented; AND author a Playwright e2e test plan for the closed loop (both modes) over the preview HTTP surface, including a governance-falsification test.

technique_overlays.trigger: Ordered handoff, validation, owner boundaries, observability for an ordinary contract+plan refinement.
technique_overlays.validation_expectation: Each non-first stage consumes a prior frame and records a receipt.

technique_overlays.trigger: The SKILL's many control statements must be classified keep/rewrite under reversibility, and the loop's HTTP/CLI surface mapped for e2e — both hidden structure.
technique_overlays.validation_expectation: An x-ray table: each SKILL control statement -> keep|rewrite; each loop step -> its testable HTTP/CLI seam.

technique_overlays.trigger: The SKILL's 'you propose, the human disposes' identity-gate philosophy vs DEC-026 reversibility-not-gating + DEC-027 auto-accept — a genuine governance-philosophy clash the rewrite must reconcile mode-by-mode.
technique_overlays.validation_expectation: Resolved posture: HUMAN accepts / AUTO auto-accepts / export the one human-confirmed edge; residue of what's lost/kept.

technique_overlays.trigger: The Playwright plan must include a test that actually catches a governance violation, not just a happy path.
technique_overlays.validation_expectation: export-without-confirm test FAILS on violation; revert-restores + auto-accept-revertible assertions hold.

subagent_strategy.trigger: A focused contract-rewrite + test-plan over well-grounded local material (the built surface + the two decisions); one design voice with internal dialectic roles suffices.
subagent_strategy.explanation: The principle is already decided (DEC-026/027); this run applies it to the SKILL prose and plans the test. Inline dialectic roles reconcile the old/new governance without sibling-agent spend.

steps.name: Context Builder evidence baseline
stop_conditions: Current SKILL spine + DEC-026/027 + the built surface + existing Playwright material captured.

steps.name: Invoke Define — x-ray the SKILL control surface + the testable loop surface
stop_conditions: Every SKILL control statement classified keep/rewrite under reversibility; the loop's HTTP/CLI surface mapped for e2e.

steps.name: Interrogation refine-review
stop_conditions: The propose/dispose-vs-reversibility reconciliation + the false 'never accept' claim confirmed as the load-bearing edits.

steps.name: Research decision
stop_conditions: Local-first; Playwright + ux-evidence-validator known; external only on a named gap + confirm.

steps.name: Distill — the minimal coherent reversibility posture + the smallest e2e that proves it
stop_conditions: A minimal posture statement (modes + export edge) + the smallest e2e path that falsifies a governance violation.

steps.name: Invoke Design — reconcile propose/dispose vs reversibility (the rewritten contract)
convergence_criteria: The old identity-gate spine vs reversibility resolved mode-by-mode: HUMAN accepts (workflow), AUTO auto-accepts (reversible), export is the one human-confirmed edge.
The never-do spine rewritten to reversibility invariants (never export w/o confirm; never bypass the fence; always revertible + honestly diffed).
Residue: what the rewrite loses/keeps from the old contract recorded.
stop_conditions: Rewritten SKILL posture + the Playwright plan shape fixed.

steps.name: Interrogation refine-design-review
stop_conditions: No stale 'never accept' survives; export confirm is the sole hard human edge; the plan has a real governance-falsification test.

steps.name: Distill Repair — toy-game (does the planned governance test catch a violation?)
stop_conditions: The plan's export-without-confirm test FAILS on violation; revert-restores + auto-accept-revertible assertions hold; repairs folded back.

steps.name: Invoke Plan — rewrite SKILL.md + author PLAYWRIGHT-CLOSED-LOOP-TEST-PLAN.md
stop_conditions: SKILL rewritten to the reversibility model; a runnable Playwright test plan over the preview surface incl. a governance-falsification test.

steps.name: Final Interrogation and Refine-owned synthesis
stop_conditions: RESULT.md synthesizes the rewritten posture + the test plan + next routes.

gates.condition: Each runtime-backed stage names its native capability handle and expected receipt before execution.
External research only if a named gap appears and the operator confirms; default local-first.
The rewritten SKILL contains no 'never accept' / identity-gate claim that contradicts DEC-026/027; every changed control statement is reconciled.
The rewrite names export (handoff export --confirm) as the one human-required irreversible edge; reversibility is the control everywhere else.
The Playwright plan includes a test that FAILS on a governance violation (export w/o confirm; non-restoring revert), not only happy paths.
Toy-game artifact demonstrates the governance test catches the violation.
Edits limited to the run folder + SKILL.md + PLAYWRIGHT-CLOSED-LOOP-TEST-PLAN.md; no test code executed; no public-push.
RESULT.md synthesized from stage artifacts, not the route proposal.

promotion_guardrails: Proposals + the SKILL/plan edits only; no test code executed.
Edits limited to run folder + SKILL.md + PLAYWRIGHT-CLOSED-LOOP-TEST-PLAN.md.
DEC-026 preserved; no public-push (the SKILL rewrite is the pre-publish fix, applied locally).
